abstract: OBJECTIVE: To review the clinicopathological experience of patients with benign and malignant struma ovarii. METHOD: A retrospective institutional analysis of 2 patients with malignant and 14 patients with benign struma ovarii, treated during a period of 20 years. RESULT: The patients with struma ovarii constituted 1.0% of all ovarian neoplasms in our institution (16/1501). Four percent of the germ cell tumors were calculated to be of struma ovarii (16/382). The stages of the malignant cases were recorded as 1A and 1C. Besides detection at early stage, a biologically low grade tumor was encountered as well. Although 5 of the patients had goitre, none of them had hyperthyroidism. None of the patients had a bilateral tumor. However, in 2 patients, a serous cystadenoma and dermoid cyst were found in the contralateral ovaries. The preoperative and intraoperative diagnosis of malignant struma ovarii proved to be difficult since 2 patients subjected to radical surgery according to suspicious frozen section reports in this series later were found to be benign struma ovarii. CONCLUSION: The low metastatic potential and slow progression rate of malignant struma ovarii support conservative surgery especially in young patients who have not yet completed their families.
abstract_ja: 目的：良性および悪性の卵巣甲状腺腫の臨床病理学的経験を検討すること。方法：20年間に治療された悪性卵巣甲状腺腫2例および良性卵巣甲状腺腫14例の後方視的な施設内解析。結果：卵巣甲状腺腫の患者は、当施設の全卵巣腫瘍の1.0%(16/1501)を占めた。胚細胞腫瘍の4%(16/382)が卵巣甲状腺腫と算出された。悪性例の病期はIA期およびIC期と記録された。早期発見に加え、生物学的に低悪性度の腫瘍も認められた。5例は甲状腺腫を有していたが、いずれも甲状腺機能亢進症はなかった。両側性の腫瘍は1例もなかった。ただし2例では対側卵巣に漿液性嚢胞腺腫および類皮嚢腫が認められた。術前および術中の悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の診断は困難であった。本研究では、疑わしい凍結切片診断に基づき根治的手術を受けた2例が、後に良性の卵巣甲状腺腫と判明した。結論：悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の転移能は低く進行も緩徐であることから、特に妊孕性の温存を希望する若年患者では保存的手術が支持される。
